name: Phantasm Orgasm
text: This tiolized IPA was made with a mission to release the maximum fruit flavors from all ingredients and production processes. Tiolized yeast from White Labs was used to release these aromatic compounds from malt, hops: Mosaic Cryo, Citra Cryo, Nectaron, and Saaz, as well as from Phantasm powder obtained from Sauvignon Blanc skins from New Zealand. The result is a fruity orgasm with 6.5% alcohol.

name: Dream Like This Must Die
text: American IpaDDH with BRU 1 + Motueka

name: Fantom IPA 2
text: Novo pivo u našoj eksperimentalnoj seriji je prekrasno zahmeljeni India Pale Ale koji nastavlja tradiciju finih Fantom piva koja su svaki put drugačija. Između šest vrsti hmeljeva koja smo koristili ističu se Ella i Enigma, te stari znanac Vic Secret. Uživajte u ovom finom i pitkom predahu od stvarnosti!

name: Kolaboracija 3
text: Kolaboracija 3 - micro NEIPATreća po redu kolaboracija s Nova Runda Brewery i Zmajska pivovara kuhana je kod nas. Plan je bio napraviti vrlo aromatično pivo koje se pije lagano s obzirom na vrućine koje nam ovih dana vrše pritisak na regiju. Nakon agresivnog sastančenja odabir je pao na micro NEIPA. Dakle, New England IPA s intenzivnim citrusnim aromama hmelja, bogato suho hmeljena, zaokruženog okusa, ali micro - svega 2,7% alkohola! To je onaj "pije se lagano" dio. ?Riwaka, Cryo Citra i Cryo Mosaic zaslužni su za bogatu citrusno aromatiku ovog piva i za sramežljivih 15 jedinica gorčine.

name: Svarog
text: Unatoč dolasku IPA-e u Hrvatsku preko Američke pivske revolucije, ovo pivopredstavlja našu pretpostavku kako je stil morao izgledati na svojem izvoru na putovanjima skroz do daleke Indije.Više alkohola, više probranog hmelja ali i mnogo okusa koje američki stilovi skrivaju - ječam, još ječma, i onda još sasvim malo ječma. Uzdravlje!

name: Novi Val
text: A different taste, a top-notch balance and a wonderful aroma of three exotic New World hops. Let's go back to the eighties and start the New Wave...

name: IPA 52
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Napravljeno od 2 vrste najfinijeg njemačkog slada i 5 vrsta najkvalitetnijeg američkog hmelja, odakle i dolazi naziv IPA 52. Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu u uspravnom položaju

name: San Servolo IPA
text: IPA pivo - specijalno ale pivo vareno od najboljih vrsta engleskog slada i hmelja, robustnog tijela i izrazito voćne arome, proizvedeno po uzoru na engleska piva koja su se brodovima prevozila u Indiju, pa su sadržavala veći postotak alkohola i hmelja da bi izdržala taj naporan put. San Servolo IPA, putovanje do Indije u vašoj čaši...

name: Rovinjsko IPA
text: Limited edition by pitko

name: Fireball
text: Seasonal IPA ideal for winter period. Full bodied, malty and hopped with Comet hops.

name: Fantom 46
text: Fantom 46 je IPA prekrasne rubin boje, odlično balansirana uz finu gorčinu i srednje tijelo koje ju čini vrlo pitkom.

name: March On
text: WE HAVE BEEN MARCHING STRONGLY SINCE (MARCH) 2013. AS OUR BIRTHDAY TRIBUTE, THIS YEAR, WE ARE JOINING PINK BOOTS SOCIETY, SUPPORTING WOMEN IN BEER. SO TAKE A MOMENT TO CELEBRATE WITH US WITH AN ALL WOMEN BREWED RED ALE, A PINK BOOTS BLEND. Pink Boots Collaboration Brew Day®. A portion of the proceeds from the sale of this beer goes to the Pink Boots Society.

name: Kaj-Pa
text: Kaj-Pa, new take on rye ipa by #lepidecki Brewery. Magnum, Chinook and Citra from hops, rye and malts. Proper, genuine rye IPA

name: Switch
text: Eksplozija aroma tropskog voća i citrusa u ovom pivu nikoga neće ostaviti ravnodušnim. Idealna kombinacija raži i američkih hmeljeva zaslužna je za ovo gorko ali iznimno aromatično pivo punog tijela. Za prave pivoljupce i one koji žele biti posebni!

name: Hop Volantis
text: Session NEIPA, hops Citra, Mosaic, Strata, Talus.

name: Anchovy Sesh.
text: Session Ipa with the new hop ANCHOVY from Segal Ranch in Yakima, Washington.Anchovy and Citra Cryo combo.

name: Microburst
text: It refreshes with citrus, lime and grapefruit aromas along with the sweet and fruity aromas of tropical fruits and nectarines. Mildly bitter, medium dry finish.

name: Hladovina
text: What could be better for hot summer days then an IPA with low ABV. This Session IPA is hopped with Galena, Mosaic and El Dorado hops which give spicy, juicy and fruity notes.

name: Bitter Hug
text: Malts: pale, wheat malt, flaked oats, carapilsHops: cascade, citra, styrian wolfYeast: verdant IPA

name: Baron De Hopard
text: Malts: Pale Ale, Carabody,  Munich Hops: Cryo Cascade, Citra, Simcoe, MosaicYeast: YF-107Extra: Orange peel, lemon peel

name: Summer Mode
text: Summer time brings summer mode. The best possible outfit to enjoy your cold summer brew is combo of mullet, sandals, comb, glasses and Session IPA!

name: Ringišpil
text: Dođi klizni mi niz grlo!Kad sunce u čelo tuče i osjetis da ti je vruće, s vjetrom laganini u kosi, vrtuljak okusa misli nek ti nosi... uskoči i zavrti svoj RINGIŠPIL!

name: Vibe
text: Hazy (some oat flakes and wheat malt) session IPA fermented using Verdant yeast. Idaho 7, Calista and Styrian Wolf hop additions on Whirlpool and dry hop only to give a gentle bitterness and plenty of flavor and aroma! Caution: This beer is such a summer thirst quencher it's practically impossible to only have 1

name: Small Batch IPA #01
text: Session IPABright and hazy light bodied IPA with hop-forward character. Strong bitterness with a lot of citrus and tropical fruit aroma. ABV 5.5%

name: Jam Session IPA
text: Session India Pale Ale is a style combining massive amounts of hops with a low alcohol percentage. The fruity notes of American hops and their pleasant bitterness will perfectly reward your palate with the taste of summer. Hops: Cascade, Chinook, Citra.

name: Ipanema Session IPA
text: Refreshing session IPA with Talus, Sabro and Riwaka hops.

name: Landsky
text: This session IPA was made in honor of one of the coolest woman in Zagreb's history - the first female ZET conductor Paula Landsky! We want our beer to be just like her - fearless and sophisticated!

name: Vragec
text: Refreshing red beer with an emphasized hoppy character, bitterness of 45 IBU and irresistible fruit flavours Hops used: East Kent Golding, Mandarina Bavaria, Mosaic, Simcoe

name: King's Session IPA
text: King's SIPA (Session IPA) offers an explosion of fruity aromas of orange, mango, and white guava, perfectly complemented by discreet hop notes of pine, resin, and stone fruit. Furthermore, you'll be charmed by the sweet aromas of biscuits and sponge cake, which enrich the experience of this beer delight. Despite its delicate body, there is a noticeable bitterness that adds complexity to the taste, while its dry and tender orange hue makes it visually appealing and a desirable choice.

name: Therapy
text: Very light and refreshing beer that go along equally well on the beach and at a business lunch. Inhale tropical aromas and dismiss all problems.

name: Session IPA
text: Angeluš . Session IPA je suho hmeljeno ale pivo sa Citra, Mosaic i Galaxy hmeljevima.

name: To je vuk!
text: It's a WOLF! To je vuk! Styrian Wolf hop with Citra and Amarillo - something new from #LepiDecki

name: Sretno Dijete
text: Sretno dijete je session IPA koja sretnim čini vas, ali i djecu jer se sa svakim prodanim pivom dio zarade donira nekoj od udruga za zaštitu djece.

name: Fjaka
text: Tropical & Vibrant. Easy drinking IPA with notes of Pineapple & Papaya

name: Grif Session IPA
text: Pivski znalci složit će se da je Session IPA već sama po sebi oksimoron. A kako bismo spojili nespojivo, potreban je i dobar grif. S obzirom na to da nam izazovi nisu strani, upustili smo se u još jednuzahtjevnu pivarsku avanturu tijekom koje smo dobili GRIF SESSION IPA, lagano pivo s malim udjelom alkohola kojeg krase odlike prave IPA-e. Hmeljna gorčina je u skladu s lakšim tijelom za što je zaslužan hmelj Magnum, dok su se za voćnu aromatičnost pobrinuli hmeljevi Mosaic i Amarillo.

name: Micro IPA
text: Balanced, easy-drinking Micro IPA, packed with tropical aromatics of peach and mango. Micro in ABV, but full of hop character and flavour.Hops Columbus, Azacca, Simcoe, GalaxyMalts Vienna, Dextrin, Wheat, Oats, Golden Naked OatsYeast Saturated

name: Micro IPA - German Comet & Lemondrop
text: An experimental low strength IPA. A well-rounded body and robust bitterness belie its alcohol content with notes of citrus, passionfruit and a light grassiness.

name: GLUTENKO
text: Our first ever gluten free beer. One of the few gluten free beers still rocking full hoppy flavor!This Session IPA was dry hopped with Citra and Ekuanot hops. Light, 5% alch, very refreshing.CAUTION! Glutenko was made with malts specially processed to reduce amount of gluten.This beer is NOT brewed in dedicated gluten free facility thus consumers extremely sensitive to gluten are to be advised. Each batch of this beer will be laboratory tested to ensure it is under 20 ppm of gluten before bottling and keging.Before ordering this beer make sure that tap lines have been properly cleaned and glasses don't have residue of previous beer.

name: Micro IPA - Mosaic & Azacca
text: A tropical low ABV IPA. Dank Mosaic hops support the intense juiciness and tropical notes of Azacca.

name: Kveik Session IPA
text: Refreshing hazy session IPA with punchy azacca and simcoe hops.  Brewed with Ebbegarden Kveik yeast for tropical fruit aromas.

name: Tulum
text: Hazy session IPA brewed with Simcoe, Mosaic and Idaho 7 made for BEER52

name: Siesta Session
text: Session IPA with Mosaic and Cascade hops.

name: Session IPA
text: Showcasing Mosaic hops in their Incognito and Spectrum forms. Big tropical notes of Pineapple and citrus.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Session IPA
text: Melon and Mango with a lingering bitter finish

name: Genije
text: Beer with ananas and citrus aroma. Made for Spar Croatia

name: Hopper
text: Nježna kombinacija cvjetnih, biljnih i citrusnih aroma, uz polusuho tijelo i sladni završetak, čini ovo pivo sposobnim ugasit svaku žeđ. Niži postotak alkohola pridonosi ugodnosti ispijanja čak iako popijete koju više!

name: New England Session IPA
text: New England Pale Ale overflowing with Azzaca, Ahtanum, and Citra and Sabro Cryo hops.  Sessionable hop bomb!Collaboration with La Pirata Brewing

name: Micro New England IPA
text: SIXTH BIRTHDAY COLLAB BREWSmooth and super sessionable low-alcohol hazy. Oozing with Pineapple, Passion Fruit & Mango

name: Hazy Session IPA
text: Tropical, juicy New England IPA with a smooth, silky mouthfeel.Hops Columbus, Simcoe, AhtanumMalts Pale, Dextrin, Wheat, OatsYeast Saturated

name: Micro NEIPA 2
text: A low-alcohol New England IPA with strong citrus, melon and tropical notes.Hops: Columbus, Zythos, Ekuanot, Citra, Mosaic

name: Small Batch Series: 20 Sour IPA
text: A little twist in our Small Batch experimental series. Hoppy IPA combined with a mighty duo of Citra and Mossaic, but this time, in kettle sour version.

name: Mrs Millers Sour Passion
text: Mrs Miller had a thirst again, but this time she wanted something more sour. We gave her the already checked recipe for a fruited NEIPA, but made sure that sourness is present to make it extra refreshing. We also used Sultana hops along with Ella, which makes this beer a proper orange juice substitute in the morning (if it wasn't for the 6% ABV)

name: Small Batch Series: 23 Sour IPA
text: Kettle Sour IPA brewed with Mosaic and Citra hops

name: Triple I.P.A
text: An imperial IPA packed with a huge punch of eye watering hops. Its continuously hopped, in small doses, over its 60 minute boil, then a heavily whirlpool addition of west coast American hops. We then continuously dry hopped it every single day during its fermentation. Once our house vermont yeast had finished, we then dry hopped it another 4 times over 2 weeks. Dank citrus, tropical fruit, pine, and floral notes assault the nose while a complex bitterness rounds out the high alcohol making this imperial monster deceptively quaffable.

name: Wheat Walker
text: Hops: Chinook, Citra, Mosaic, Centennial."Imperial hoppy wheat", citrus, tropical fruit, mild floral aroma.

name: Hop Expedition: Yakima #3 White IPA
text: Yakima #3 is a White IPA brewed with Citra Dynaboost, Mosaic Dynaboost, and Citra Cryo hops.

name: Keller Helles #1
text: Crisp unfiltered lager. Gentle herbal aromas

name: Keller Helles
text: A classic unfiltered lager. Crisp and bready with soft herbal aromas.

name: Kölsch
text: Svijetlo, pitko pivo porijeklom iz Kelna, Njemacka. Donosi najbolje iz svijeta ale-a i lagera. Lagano,svježe i pitko pivo je savršeni prijatelj za tople dane. Pivo za ugasiti žeđ.

name: St. Martin's
text: St. Martin's is a kolsch styled beer brewed in Međimurje with a special thermal water and support by Lifeclass Sv. Martin, a thermal spa and hotel resort.

name: Medo Veliki
text: Pivovara Medvedgrad i Duh u boci udružili su znanje i strast u priči koja briše granice između pivarstva i destilerstva i stvorili whiskey NEBO. Početak whiskeya i ovog piva je isti, napravljeni su od istog slada u istoj pivovari, a kasnije su nastavili svatko svojim zvjezdanim putem. Medo Veliki je bogato, zaokruženo i ugodno dugotrajno pivo s whiskey karakterom.

name: Heroj Ulice
text: Heroj ulice je pivo s misijom: pomoći udrugama koje pomažu ljudima u potrebi. 30 centi od svake boce i litre točenog piva donira se udruzi koja pomaže socijalno ugroženim osobama. Ovaj amber lager ima 5,3% alkohola i 31 IBU – to je osvježavajući i pitki lager duboke jantarne boje, sladnog okusa i pripitomljene gorčine s laganim citrusnim i karamelnim okusima u pozadini.

name: Ožujsko Amber
text: Special birthday beer - 120 anniversary - with three special types of malt and two species of hops (one of it is saaz).

name: San Servolo Premium Crveno Pivo
text: San Servolo premium red beer is unfiltered and unpasteurized beer, which ensures high naturalness of product, rich in vitamins B-complex, with refined taste of all the ingredients, with dominating taste of slightly roasted coffee with a slight sense of caramel and expressed bitterness that refreshes. Additional fermentation that takes place in the bottle gives the beer naturally occurring carbon dioxide and pleasant pungency and frothiness

name: Črni
text: Dark lager, with notes of coffee, dark chocolate and balance between sweetness and bitterness. We dedicate this beer to two apsolute legends, John and Črni.

name: Turopoljsko Tamno
text: Lager tamno pivo

name: San Servolo Tamno Pivo
text: Tamno pivo - luksuzne note kavovine i čokolade, u ovom baršunastom, kremastom a opet laganom pivu, daju čak četiri vrste slada koje se koriste za njegovu proizvodnju. Njegovu iznimnu aromu zaokružuju dvije vrste egzotičnih hmeljeva koji naglašuju laganu citrusnu notu koja oduševljava! Idealno za ispijanje u zimskim mjesecima uz razna variva, meke sireve i razne deserte!

name: Karlovačko Crno
text: European black lager with 14.5% extract makes this good dark beer with 6% ABV a joy to taste!

name: Panonska Dark Lager
text: Dark Lager je tamni lager kesten smeđe boje i bogate pjene, raskošnog okusa karamele.

name: Rosa - Unfiltered Keller Helles
text: Crisp and refreshing lager with gentle herbal aromas

name: Küss die Hand
text: Novo pivo Küss die Hand (Ljubim ruku) oživljava kulturu ophođenja građanskog društva u Zagrebu u velikom dijelu prošlog stoljeća. Bio je to uobičajeni pozdrav damama koji su upućivala gospoda finih manira, uz blagi naklon.Pivo Küss die Hand je jedan pristojan helles, vješto skuhan u tradicionalnoj bavarskoj maniri. Svoj dobar odgoj pokazat će svakom ljubitelju lagera kroz izuzetnu pitkost, nježne note slada i nenametljiv biljni karakter plemenitih hmeljeva.

name: Šlager
text: Classic clear and bright Bavarian type helles. Sligthly malty and toasty, with touch of german noble hop flavour and aroma.

name: TRIA (Tri Mrtvaca) HELLES
text: TRIA rebranded! Međimursko grainbill brewed with helles yeast

name: Karet
text: Just lika dalmatian karet, this beer is a playful combination of tradition and simplicity.Satisfaction guaranteed.

name: Lager
text: Angeluš - Lager je pitko i osvježavajuće pivo izraženih aroma biskvita, tosta, začina i cvijeća.

name: Lagerica
text: To brew proper good lager takes years of experience, lot of knowledge and passion for perfection. It took us some time to achieve all those things but we made it! Lagerica is finally here for you guys. Tradicional german hops gave true german character to this munich helles lager. Easygoing, smooth and delicious. Enjoy!

name: Perun
text: Perun is a classic helles, hopped with German Tettnager, Chech Saaz and Slovenian Savinja Golding hops. The light but balanced body owes it's taste to the Munich and Vienna malts, and a long and slow mash.Non filtered, non pasteurised. Minimum production time 61 days.

name: Burger Beer
text: Submarine Burger Beer! Together with friends from Garden Brewery, we’ve brewed a lager that makes burgers taste even better!

name: Munich Helles
text: A clean, crisp lager with bready and herbal notes.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities

name: Profesor
text: Već ste probali našeg Baltazara, a sada je pred vama njegov mlađi brat Profesor! Sličnost s Baltazarom je očita u istom kvascu i hmeljevima - Mandarina Bavaria, Citra i Simcoe – ali Profesora smo nahranili s puuuno više hmelja. Ili kako bi rekao naš pivar Božo: Profesor je Baltazar na steroidima!

name: Priroda i Društvo
text: Priroda i društvo četvrto je u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice. Ovaj double hoppy lager svijetlo je i snažno pivo, tropskih i citrusnih okusa koji potječu od velike količine američkih hmeljeva, srednjeg tijela i balansirane gorčine.

Rođendansko pivo - 31 - double je India pale lager,  moderni hibrid fermentiran s lager kvascem, ali obilno hmeljen u stilu New England piva. Punokusan, tropski aromatičan, s visokim postotkom alkohola.

name: Small Batch Series: 43 DDH Pilsner
text: A DDH Pilsner brewed with Styrian Kolibri and Mosaic hops.

name: Fantom Juicy Lager
text: New England India Pale Lager brewed in collaboration with Matt Hollingsworth. Hops: Citra, Mosaic and El Dorado

name: All My Friends Are Skeletons
text: We continued with West Coast lager series inspired by west coast bands and lyrics from their songs.Brewed with Mosaic, Simcoe, Amarillo and Altus. This IPL brings citrusy and resinous aromas packed with danky notes for true WC!Old school flavors in crushable lager body! Well, all my friends are Indians...All my friends are brown and red.SpoonmanAnd all my friends are skeletons...They beat the rhythm with their bonesSpoonman!

name: Fantom India Pale Lager
text: Fantom je humanitarno pivo koje vraća vjeru u bolje sutra! Fantom na etiketi je anonimni dobrotvor, zaštitnik ugroženih i borac za pravdu, a sva zarada donira se Klubu roditelja nedonoščadi „Palčići“, odnosno za njihov projekt „Vratimo Palčiće u Petrovu". Ovaj poseban lager oduševljava bogatim tijelom te moćnim hmeljnim karakterom. Dominira čarolija Sabro hmelja iz kojeg dolaze arome tropskog voća i kokosa.#ostanitedoma i uživajte u ovom pitkom i ukusnom predahu od stvarnosti!

name: Dusty Thumb
text: A hitchhiker's guide to the Roy's Peak in New Zealand - be confident, put the thumb out, and wait for the taxi called by your mates from the pub.

name: Fantom 51
text: Fantom 51 je New England IPL - mutni, aromatični lager inspiriran NEIPA stilom, s naglašenim tropskim i citrusnim notama hmelja. Punog je tijela, kremaste teksture, umjerene gorčine i odličnog balansa svježine, sočnosti i pitkosti.

name: Captain Badfish
text: We continued with West Coast lager series inspired by west coast bands and their songs.This brew is special one because is a collab beer with Greece beer bar and supplier - Last Row ON HOPS WE SAIL!

name: Give It To Me Baby
text: Here we go - our new West Coats lager in our series inspired by west coast American bands!Full of Citra, Mosaic, Simcoe and Eclipse, it's easy going with some hoppy kick. The Offspring baby!'Give it to me baby!'This is why we brew!
Specijalno, rođendansko pivo - 30 - je double India pale lager. Vrlo je jako pivo savršenog balansa, tijela i gorčine. Ova sočna bomba tropsko – citrusnih nota nikoga neće ostaviti ravnodušnim.

name: Voodoo Child
text: We continued with West Coast lager series inspired by west coast bands and their songs.Brewed with Strata, Mosaic, Simcoe and Vista. Vibrant dankness with citrusy notes.If I don't meet you no more in this world then uhI'll meet ya on the next oneAnd don't be lateDon't be lateCause I'm a Voodoo Child Voodoo ChildLord knows I'm a Voodoo Child

name: There Goes My Hero
text: Our new 'west coast' lager is here! This time we brewed up our story about one of the west coast band lyrics with our friend Ugo Stegnjaić from King's Brew.This heavily hopped lager with Simcoe, Citra, Mosaic and Strata is a kind of homage to the prematurely deceased Taylor Hawkins from one of our favorite bands. So enjoy, and let's make a toast.'There goes my hero. Watch him as he goes. There goes my hero. He's ordinary.'

name: Dinosaur Victrola
text: A dinosaur Victrola listening to Buck Owens.Doo, doo, doo, Looking out my back door...Just like 'First Born Unicorn', we have found our inspiration for name and label design in wect coast, old school rock band  - Creedence Clearwater Revival - and their hit......Doo, doo, doo, Looking out my back door...

name: Cruise Control
text: hops: Ekuanot, Idaho 7, MosaicFOLLOW THE HOPS, IGNORE THE GPS!

name: First Born Unicorn
text: A first 'born' beer in 2023!We wanted to do a new crazy beer label to open 2023 year. Something funny and crazy, a fluffy beast, raging unicorn in princess outfit, hardcore softporn... It is a west coast lager. For all rockheads, you know where we have found our inspiration for name and label...We really put enough hops to enhance citrusy, floral, herbal and bit spicy aromas.Like true west coast beer, clean, hoppy and bit bitter. With lower alcohol than IPA, it is meant to be drinkable all day and night, just like lager should be.Man, this is a tastefull beer! This is why we brew!

name: Never Never Land
text: A first new beer 2024!We continued with West Coast lager series inspired by west coast bands and their songs. 'First Born Unicorn' and 'Dinosaur Victrola' were first two labels. This time  we have found our inspiration for name and label design in Metallica's absolute hit - Enter Sandman!"Sleep with one eye openGripping your pillow tightExit lightEnter nightTake my handWe're off to never-never land..."Easy-going lager with hoppy kick!This is why we brew!

name: 4 Dečka
text: Treće u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice je session lager - osvježavajući lager kompleksnog okusa koji spaja pitkost lagera i voćnost ale piva. Biljno, tropsko i citrusno pivo, laganog tijela i suhog završetka.

name: #KRIVA
text: This beer is made for one special place - A most unusual garden, unique bar in Zagreb. Cool place for chill and relax with little treehouse in garden. Easy going lager hopped with american hops. Life is great.

name: Kelnerica
text: Kelnerica je pivo koje smo u kolaboraciji s pivovarom i pivnicom Mlinarica zamislili kao prikaz onoga što njemački hmelj nove generacije može dati u pivu. Naglasak je prvenstveno na Calista hmelju, ovaj puta u Lupomax formi, koji pivi daje još više arome i okusa koji podsjećaju na bobičasto voće i naranču. I ovog puta smo odabrali poznati njemački lager kvasac kako bi hmeljne note uz laganu sladnost došle do što većeg izražaja.

name: IPL
text: India Pale Lager - traditional lager with aromatic hops - Amarillo, Citra, Simcoe and Nelson Sauvin.

name: Bonaca
text: Light & Refreshing. Generously dry hopped for Citrus, Peach & Pine notes

name: Baltazar
text: Hoppy lager with a fruity flavour and a slight bitterness of 45 IBU. For this unusual lager we used Simcoe, Citra and Mandarin Bavaria hops.

name: Bunny Hoppy
text: Lager made from the freshest hops which create an amazing aroma. Powered by Greyp bikes!

name: Hendrix
text: Session lager, enriched with exotic New Zealand hops, primarily Nelson Sauvin. Extremely refreshing and tasty, with beautiful aromas. In honor of legendary Hendrix Bridge.

name: Huncut
text: German style pilsner lager dry hopped with American hops. Very refreshing and light drinking specially in hot summer days!

name: Hoppy Lager
text: Light lager dry hopped with Cascade hops.

name: Babaroga
text: Hoppy lager

name: Munich Dunkel
text: Winter beer with bready flavor and warm notes of chocolate, caramel and nuts

name: Mrki Medvjed
text: A dark lager, red in colour and refreshing in taste, mildly bitter and with the characteristic taste of caramelised malt. Mrki medvjed (Brown bear) is available throughout the year.

name: Fantom 32
text: Voćni, slatko - kiseli, osvježavajući lager s višnjom.

name: Turopoljsko Zlato
text: Lager svijetlo pivo

name: Hoppy Lager

name: Palisade Pale

A single hop pale ale showcasing the American hop Palisade. Grown in the ‘hop belt’ of America’s Northwest by Select Botanicals Group, Palisade is an aroma hop known for its high yield and its unique aroma profile. Described as earthy, floral, and fruity with notes of apricot and grass. The higher myrcene levels found in Palisade are what contribute to the piney, citrus ,and fruity complexities found in its aroma.

name: Hoppykumulus
text: This is a collaboration beer between Bura Brew and Hotch Potch. If you were wondering what clouds taste like, you are about to find out: we joined forces with Bura Brew and tamed some clouds to serve you in glass. When you order our cloudy ale, don't be surprised with the smell of gummy bears and a hint of pear in flavor. Taming of clouds was a long process. They were so bitter at first that we have to give them a whole load of yellow gummy bears for the balance. As well for some unknown reason, they responded well when we gave them pears. Gummy bears and pears. And it was all yellow, and so is this ale.

text: Malt, citrus, fruits, juicy

name: SON OF THE BEACH
text: EXTRA PALE ALE FOR LEMMY49% Motherhopper and 51% Son Of The BeachDDH with Galaxy Quantum, Superdelic, Motueka, Sabro CryoCrank up the volume and raise your glass to the Man!

name: Dry Hopped Callista Pilsner
text: Super refreshing dry hopped pilsner fermented with a traditional Bavarian lager yeast with an ultra light, all-German malt base. Showcasing Callista hops developed at the Hull Research Institute, displaying vibrant aromas of apricot, pears, and strawberries, balanced with a crisp bitterness. A heatwave essential!

name: PLZ
text: Naše prvo core pivo - nefiltrirani češki pilsner.Varen s bohemian sladom, dvostrukom dekokcijom i legendarnim Saaz hmeljem, sve po p.s.-u!Zapamtite: u Češkoj se pije najviše piva po glavi stanovnika, a valjda ljudi znaju što rade!

name: Mali Purger
text: Brewed to celebrate a newborn at Mlinarica, this Bohemian Pils is all about balance and drinkability. Medium-full body with gentle breadiness and smooth malt character, with Saaz hops for a classic, noble, bitter, elegant finish. Soft, rounded, and dangerously easy to drink.Cheers to Mali Purger!

name: Zaboky 12 Ležak
text: Zaboky Ležak 12 is a homage to the Czech brewing tradition, crafted with the purity and precision it deserves. The result is a symphony of crisp malt character, accented by subtle floral and spicy notes from the noble Saaz hops.

name: Czech This Out!
text: BeeReady, and it's the 'Best of Show Beer at SMASH Homebrew Competition 2024. To get the story, this is a few words from our friends from #SMASH.'We are proud to announce that this year's best beer at the SMASH Homebrew competition was brewed by the talented Finn Markku and is headed your way. His 'Pale Czech Lager' won the hearts of the judges and the audience, and was declared the best of all submitted beers. As a prize for Best Of Show, Markku got the opportunity to brew his winning beer at the renowned Pulfer Brewery.'Needless to say, we are very pleased that we participated in this cool project in which we exchanged brewing tips, and had a great time along the way. Special thanks to all the guys from SMASH Homebrew Competition, CroCraft, and of course to the Markku.

name: Lager
text: Posljednje u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice svijetli je lager pod imenom Lager. Ovaj bohemian pilsner izraženog je sladnog okusa, izbalansiran s finom gorčinom koja dolazi od čeških hmeljeva.

name: Čakovečko
text: In the north there lies Čakovec, an old town with its mysteries, adventure and dragons. Čakovečko is a pilsner style beer released on 27/03/2019

name: Glider
text: Provjerena češka receptura i klasični pivski stil na Crafter's način! Pitko, lagano pivo sa cvijetnim aromama garantirano osvježava u svakoj prilici.

name: 5th Element Bonner
text: Karakterizira ga ugodna hmeljna gorčina, za nas tradicionalnih slovenskih hmeljeva Aurore i Goldinga, nadopunjena slatkoćom slada s hrvatskih polja. Jednostavno LJUBAV sa češkim otiskom koji objedinjuje najkvalitetnije sirovine tradicionalnog podrijetla koje koristimo kroz našu dugu povijest stvaranja piva.

name: Krigla
text: Krigla je drugo pivo u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice. Osvježavajuće, lagano svijetlo pivo, savršenog balansa slatkoće slada i njemačkih hmeljeva uz ugodnu gorčinu.

name: Fantom German Pilsner
text: Novi Fantom - novo pivo. Ovoga puta naš pivar je skuhao klasik - Extra Pale Premium Pilsner - perjanicu njemačkog pivarstva. Plemeniti hmeljevi - Tettnager, Mittelfruh, Spalter - daju mu pitkost, gorčinu te prepoznatljiv karakter. Prost!

name: Wintress
text: Brewed with Perle and Saphir hops, it's modern pilsner.Golden colored, crisp with fruity notes, dry with bitter end, highly crushable.

name: King's Pilsner
text: King's Pilsner (German Pilsner), captivates with its combination of dominant floral and spicy hop aromas, perfectly balanced with subtle fruity notes of red berries. Additionally, it features malt aromas of crackers, bread crust, and sweet dough, creating an irresistible sensation on the palate. In the aftertaste, a pleasant moderate bitterness is felt, while the drinking experience remains crisp, smooth, and refreshing. Moreover, our Pilsner beer boasts a beautiful thick creamy foam that lingers atop the glass, while its white gold color further enhances the aesthetic pleasure.

name: Angry Moose
text: Yep, we finally brewed L A G E R! After 5 years of our ale loyalty, we decided it's time to dive into lager production. 6 months of in depth analysis of Pilsner style, and many trial and errors during that period resulted with this classic German style Pils.

name: Oktobeer Pilsner #2
text: German-style Pils with Slovenian Styrian Kolibri hops. Refreshing & Floral.

name: Bright Arrow
text: Bright Arrow is the story of Prince Domagoj and the Neretva pirates who protected their coasts and the right to the sea by piracy. This German Pilsner is a light lager beer with a light body and low bitterness with light hop aromas.

name: Devetka La9er
text: Naš La9er je lagano pivo hmeljne arome, blage i ugodne gorčine, zlatne boje, bogate i čvrste pjene te, ono najvažnije, nevjerojatno pitko i osvježavajuće. Devetka La9er neće vas ostaviti ravnodušnima. Svaki novi gutljaj pozivati će vas na još, a užitak će biti potpun uz samo 4,5%  alkohola. Naš La9er jednostavno je Enjoyable.

name: GRIF Pilsner
text: GRIF Pilsner je naša posveta klasičnom njemačkom pilsneru. Riječ je o laganom i pitkom pivu čiju naglašenu cvjetnu notu dobivamo korištenjem plemenitog njemačkog aromatičnog hmelja Tettnager.GRIF Pilsner smo dugo ukomljavali te fermentirali na niskim temperaturama s diacetilnog stankom na kraju primarne fermentacije nakon čega je slijedio pretok, odležavanje te punjenje. Rezultat je nefiltriran i nepasteriziran pilsner koji je idealno popiti svježe natočenog na temperaturi od 3 do 8 Celzijevaca. Kako bi Nijemci rekli - prost!

name: Pilsner | Zora
text: This is our take on a traditional German Pilsner. A full malt bill; bready and soft caramel notes which has been generously hopped with a blend of Hallertauer Mittlefruh and Saaz hops and fermented with a classic Bavarian yeast. Clean, crisp and classic.

name: Fulir
text: German style pilsner lager with clean and dry refreshing taste.

name: CugMajstor
text: Plemeniti pilsnerMajstori pivari: Matt Hollingsworth i Božidar KostanjčarHmeljevi: Aurora, Tettnanger, Hallertauer Mittelfrueh

name: Palooza
text: Collab with LZO Brewery from Italy. Hop: Cascade

name: Giro Sul Luppolo
text: You have to cross the finish line in the first place if you want to win! This universal equation sounds simple but you have to infuse your body with enough hoppy electrolytes to achieve it. #PerLaVittoria

name: Italian Pilsner
text: Crisp & clean with a citric squeeze of Italian Oranges & Lemons

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #3 - Motueka
text: Split Rock Pilsner V3 takes you to New Zealand's Pikimai hop farm, where Motueka hops grow wild! This version is dry-hopped exclusively with Motueka, delivering a crisp and dry finish.

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #2 - Motueka And Riwaka
text: Crafted with traditional double decoction and Motueka and Riwaka hops, it strikes the perfect balance between drinkability and distinctive hop character that only New Zealand can provide.

name: Phial of Light
text: We have continued with beer series inspired by Tolkien's Middle Earth!It's hoppy pilsner brewed with Nelson Sauvin, Nectaron and light of Eärendil's star."... slowly he held aloft the Phial of Galadriel. ... then as its power waxed, and hope grew in Frodo’s mind, it began to burn, and kindled to a silver flame, a minute heart of dazzling light, as though Eärendil had himself come down from the high sunset paths with the last Silmaril upon his brow."

name: Small Batch Series: 71 New Zealand Juicy Pilsner
text: Hoppy and juicy Pils brewed with Nelson Sauvin and New Zealand Cascade.

name: Small Batch Series: 57 Oceania Pilsner
text: A Pilsner brewed with Motueka, Vic Secret, and Rakau hops.

name: Princess of Zeland
text: Malts: Pils,  Munich,  CaraBodyHops: Nectaron, Motueka, Kohatu, SuperdelicYeast: W34/70

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #4 - Nelson Sauvin
text: And we are in round 4 of our Split Rock Pilsner series. This time, we are going full Nelson Sauvin from New Zealand's Pikimai hop farm. We dry-hopped this NZ boy to push those wine-like notes while keeping it properly bitter and dry.

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #1 - Nelson And Cascade
text: The Split Rock watches over another expression of New Zealand's hops - pairing the Nelson Sauvin with Cascade hops. This Pilsner is showcasing how the same terrain can produce entirely different flavor profiles.

name: Zvir
text: Pale, dry, golden coloured, combines citrus fruits which dominate in aroma (lemon, lime, tangerine, grapefruit) with a background of sweet fruit notes of pineapple and mango.Hop: Riwaka, Motueka

name: Flame of the West
text: "Very bright was that sword when it was made whole again; the light of the sun shone redly in it, and the light of the moon shone cold, and its edge was hard and keen. And Aragorn gave it a new name and called it Andúril, Flame of the West."

name: Heart of the Mountain
text: We have continued with beer series inspired from Middle Earth!Crushable, easy-going hoppy pilsner brewed with Mosaic and New Zealand hops - Nelson Sauvin, Wai-iti and Motueka. Lots of tropical and limelike flavours, stonefruits and spiciness. We love it!

name: King of the Nine
text: "Upon it sat a shape, black-mantled, huge and threatening. A crown of steel he bore, but between rim and robe naught was there to see, save only a deadly gleam of eyes: the Lord of the Nazgûl... now he was come again, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death. A great black mace he wielded. "

name: New Zealand Dry Hopped Pilsner #7
text: Crisp and vibrant lager with mineral notes and Clementine, Melon, and Mango aromas

name: Fantom 48
text: Ovaj pilsner izdvaja se specifičnim hmeljnim profilom s potpisom iz dalekog Novog Zelanda. Lagane sladne baze, fine gorčine i osvježavajućeg završetka.

name: Small Batch Series : 45 Luminosa Pilsner
text: Pilsner brewed with Luminosa hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 70 DDH Juicy Pilsner
text: Number 70 from our Small Batch Series is a DDH Juicy Pils hopped with Mosaic, Citra, and Sabro hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 49 Juicy Pilsner
text: Juicy Pilsner brewed with Citra, Galaxy, and Mosaic hops.

name: Small Batch Series : 46 DDH Hazy Pilsner
text: Pils brewed with Nectaron, Bru-1, and Styrian Kolibri hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 55 Juicy Pilsner
text: Juicy Pilsner brewed with Motueka, Columbus, and HBC 630 hops.

name: Small Batch Series : 48 DDH Pilsner
text: Double dry hopped pilsner brewed with El Dorado, Amarillo, Simcoe and Mosaic hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 37 New Zealand Hazy Kveik Pilsner
text: Pilsner brewed with a Kveik yeast.

name: Small Batch Series: 74 New England Pale Pilsner
text: The latest edition of the Small Batch Series is a New England Pale Pilsner brewed with Mosaic, Citra, and Sabro hops.

name: East Coast German Pilsner
text: East Coast Pilsner, with the West Coast twist!

name: Small Batch Series: 77 L.A. Mountain Pilsner
text: Low gravity Pilsner brewed with Sabro, HBC 630 and Citra hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 81 Amarillo Pilsner
text: Dry hopped Pilsner with Amarillo hops.

name: Englishman In York
text: In the distance, I see the City Walls,A ton of people moving on,Barker Tower is forming on the Ouse,I'm an Englishman in York.

name: Small Batch Series: 56 Citra Pilsner
text: Small Batch 56 is a Pilsner brewed with Citra hops.

name: Triple Hophead
text: They say jump and you say how high? Whit this one, the sky is the limit! Styrian trio of hops - Styrian Kolibri, Styrian Bobek, and Styrian Celeia will make you obey the rules, 'cause you'll just fly higher and higher!

name: Small Batch Series: 76 L.A. Juicy Pilsner
text: Low Gravity Pils brewed with Motueka and Riwaka hops.

name: HOPA
text: Just like the song says, this Hopa Pilsner is as easy-drinking as a Sunday morning. It's light-bodied and crisp with a refreshing 3.8% ABV, perfect for unwinding on a sunny day with a gentle breeze.

name: Kraljevsko Pilsner
text: Nefiltrirano, nepastetizirano pilsner pivo nastalo po pomno izbalansiranoj i dokazanoj craft recepturi. Jedinstveni okus svježine daje mu priroradna izvorska voda rijeke Krke koja se rađa na obroncima najviše hrvatske planine Dinare duboko u damatinskom zaleđu odakle je u 11. stoljeću vladao hrvatski kralj Dmitar Zvonimir u čiju čast ovo pivo i nosi naziv Kraljevsko. Rezervirano za kraljeve.

name: Goodara Navijačko - Pilsner
text: #hrvatska!

name: Zadranka
text: Pilsner beer with a refreshing balance and drinkability with subtle malt notes of white bread and crackers. Spalter and Hallertau Blanc hops provide a refreshing bitterness and an herbal and floral flavor and aroma that finishes crisp and clean. The perfect solution to your year round thirst!

name: Hoppy Morphosis
text: Given the opportunity, after the Czech This Out!¨collaboration, we decided to tweak the winning Markku Leminen's recipe from this year's SMASH Homebrew Competition. Just a little bit.To the fantastic base, we added the Czech modern hops in the phase of dry hopping - Saturn and Kazbek, which blended very nicely with the previously incorporated Saaz. It gives us a very nice addition of floral, spicy, and tropical flavors and aromas. So good. Mr. Kafka would be pleased.

name: Bošnjak Svijetli Lager
text: Pasteurized pale lager.

name: Mango Pilsner
text: Crisp and refreshing with a sweet Mango hit.

name: Gad
text: Gad je naš vrhunski uradak, crispy lager, vrhunsko lager pivo skuhano sa slovenskim hmeljem Styrian Golding daje mu punoću okusa. Gad je pivo zlatno-prozirne boje, jako pitko, na okus daje aromu ječmenog slada u kombinaciji sa blagom zahmeljenošću s Styrian hmeljem, jednom kad probate Gada više nikada nećete piti industrijska piva sumnjive kvalitete.

name: Pils
text: The secret of this wickedly drinkable pilsner beer is a perfect ratio of freshness and bitterness. Flowery hop aromas arise from noble hops and bready-rich malt aroma from local Slavonian malt.

name: Zlatni Medvjed
text: A pilsener with a golden-yellow colour, a refreshing taste and a pleasantly bitter aroma. We brew Zlatni medvjed (Golden bear) throughout the year. Golden Bear is the same style of beer with same ingredients as original beer Zlatni medvjed, only this one was made especially for UK market with English label.

name: Hajduk 1911
text: Official beer for the Croatian football club Hajduk Split

name: 5th Element LELA
text: A unique blend of two beer style Alea and lager beer gives the best of both style and makes it as easy as the element that is symbolized - WATER. Ale beer adds a mild hoppy / ester flavor which has only beer fermented at a higher temperature while lager beer gives the basic body and the freshness of the beer this unique blend.

name: Small Batch #9 Baltic Porter
text: Aromas of dark and dried fruit, caramel and chocolate truffles, with hints of licorice and porto wine. Sweet, with traditional hops and warm alcohol.

name: Piece of Cake
text: BraIlian Montecristo medium roast coffee as an initial aroma, followed right away by the complex marzipan, vanilla, cinnamon from the tonka beans. First taste again brings the coffee to the front, with a direct transition to dark chocolate flavour contributed by the cocoa nibs, however it's the tonka that justifies the name of our beer, making it a proper liquid cake. The clean lager character can be recognised in the finishing smoothness, and the aftertaste is again a lingering combination of rich coffee and tonka complexity.

name: Blackberry Baltic Porter #8
text: Roasty, dark, smooth and fruity with fresh blackberries

name: Majstorica Maruška
text: LIMITIRANO IZDANJE.Prva kolaboracija Maraske Zadar s Brlogom. Gusto, tamno, desertno pivo bogatog tijela s infuziranom višnjom maraskom proizašlom iz proizvodnje slavnog Maraschina. Pivo koje razvija kulturu suradnje na lokalnoj razini i spaja svjetove.Sastav: voda, ječmeni slad, hmelj, kvasac, višnja maraska.

name: Fantom Fehér Nyúl Baltic Porter
text: Čokoladno - karamelasti Fantom Baltic Porter skuhan je u suradnji s mađarskom craft pivovarom Fehér Nyúl Brewery & Taproom.

name: 8 Sons
text: 8 Sons is a collaboration between eight brothers, four Croatians and four Dutch, that have two things in common: an engineer father and a family craft brewery. Moersluetel Craft Brewery brews big, bold and flavourful beers and Medvedgrad Brewery is specialized for tasty lagers. A big and bold Baltic Porter is the result of this unique collaboration, a strong and complex dark lager with coffee and dark chocolate flavors. Let's surf forever on waves of delicious beers!

name: 5th Element BART
text: Ovo pivo simbolizira element ZEMLJA. Spravljeno je u stilu Baltic porter koji karakteriziraju intenzivni sladni okusi s naglašenom notom prženih sladova te povećani sadržaj alkohola. Zbog korištenja 7 vrsta specijalnog slada savršeno prezentira element ZEMLJE koja simbolizira slad.

name: Tomislav
text: Tomislav's black royal beer - the first and best-selling special beer in Croatia.Dates from 1925, when it was first produced in honor of the thousandth anniversary of the coronation of King Tomislav.Tomislav is the right choice for true connoisseurs of specialty beers that enjoy special flavors.It differs from other black beer market as the only products of toasted malt, which gives it a distinctive caramel flavor.

name: Flat White Coffee Porter
text: Cold-brew iced-coffee porter: rich, smooth and creamy with notes of roasted almond and dark chocolate

name: Porter
text: Angeluš - Porter je tamno ale pivo intenzivnih aroma kave, čokolade, vanilije i bobičastog voća.

name: Tàmān Támān
text: Svilenkasto suhovoćni direkt te tamno čokoladni aperkat s blagim kavenim krošeom u baršunastom taman tamnom biskvitnem tijelu...

name: Baltic Porter
text: A silky and robust baltic porter reminiscent of raisin, burnt caramel, roasted coffee and molasses.  Very malty and somewhat sweet, it finishes with a dry and balanced bitter taste. The aroma is molasses and malt. Like a moderately hopped bock, with chocolate and coffee notes. This brew is bottom fermented and well rounded, with its potency hidden in its easy-drinking quality.  Rummy, raisin and liquorice notes similar to an old ale reside in the profile. The character also has hints of chocolate and coffee, and at times, a roasted background.

name: The Whole Cake
text: After a few repetitions od the crowds favorite Piece of Cake, we decided it's enough slicing,  so here's the whole cake: more alcohol, more Tonka, cocoa and coffee, more pleasure!

name: Vanilla & Chocolate Porter
text: A vanilla and chocolate porter aged on French oak and rested on organic cocoa nibs and Madagascar vanilla pods.Like velvet on the tongue - chocolate, coffee and dark caramel - it pours heavy with a very thick, dominating head. The aroma is strong dark chocolate with subtle notes of coffee and vanilla. The lactose and vanillin (from the oak) beautifully round the flavours together. A little thin and bitter, like a porter should be, this leaves a slightly roasted coffee bean sensation. After swallowing this soft bitterness gives way to a long lasting vanilla coating on the palate.

name: Hazel Cake Porter
text: Porter brewed with Cocoa nibs, hazelnut and lactose. Special birthday edition

name: Smoked Slavonian Plum Porter
text: Heaps of juicy, ripe Croatian plums, from our nearby region of Slavonia, combine with specialty smoked malts to create a rich, complex, and robust Porter. This is a brew of profound depth, where sweet fruit meets a lingering, smoky complexity to make the perfect autumn evening accompaniment.

name: The Blueberry Side
text: A fruit beer based on The Dark Side porter - porter with the addition of blueberries. 150g of fresh eko Lisjak blueberrys per 1 liter of the beer. Slightly bitter, lots of coffee and sourness of blueberries from EKO LISJAK farm!

name: GRIF Vanilla Bourbon Oak Porter
text: Porter, spravljen od čak 6 vrsta slada među kojima su dva tamna, pržena slada koji se ističu svojim aromama pržene kave i tamne čokolade. Dodatak zobenih pahuljica daje mu bogato, jako tijelo s čvrstom pjenom, a mahune vanilije odležane u najkvalitetnijem Bourbon whiskyu zajedno s hrastovim čipsom našem Porteru daju specifičnu aromu u kojoj prevladava kombinacija prženog slada sa suptilnim okusima i mirisima vanilije, Bourbon whiskya te hrastovine.

name: Bumbarska Tamna
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Ovo tamno pivo napravljeno je od 2 vrste specifičnih hmeljeva i kombinacije 5 vrsta najboljih europskih sladova koje PORTER i zaslužuje! Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu u uspravnom položaju.

name: The Dark Side
text: From the dark side of the moon comes #lepidecki's first porter, The Dark Side, a 5.5 ABV, less bitter, the darkest beer they ever made.An obvious reference two of our biggest inspiration, a sci-fi story and a hell of a music album, the dark side will be hitting shops soon!

name: Porter
text: Dark Chocolate, coffee, dried fruit and caramel. No, you're not reading a recipe for your favourite cake. These are the flavours and aromas blended in harmony within this classic British style ale. Combining variety of six malts and one hop resulted in this pleasantly bitter beer.It's as robust as it gets!

name: Bob Barley
text: Enter a jungle of roasted malts, blowing coffee and chocolate flavours through the air. Light up the darkness and you’ll fly on a cloud of good vibrations…Love the beer you drink, drink the beer you love. –Bob Barley

name: Oak Aged Vanilla & Chocolate Porter
text: Luxurious Chocolate Porter rested on Vanilla and Oak.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Fantom 38
text: Fantom 38 pripada tradicionalnom njemačkom pivskom stilu Rauchbier Märzen. Dimljeno pivo, srednje jako, ugodnog balansa gorčine i sladnosti.

name: Zornjak
text: HÖPPY AMBER

name: Neposlušna
text: Neposlušna je red ale buntovnica bez filtera. Arome hmelja i toplinu karamele spaja u slobodnom duhu zadrugarstva

name: Devetka Red Ale
text: Ovaj stil kuhanja još uvijek nema visoko mjesto na craft listi cijenjenih piva. Uzmite pržene i blage slatke karamelne note pažljivo probranih sladova. Uravnotežite ih aromama biljnog i itrusnog hmelja. Što ćete dobiti? Hoppy Red Ale! Pivo predivne rubin boje. Iako se odlikuje svom puninom gorčine, nevjerojatno dobro pristaje svakoj hrani. No ni sam po sebi nikoga neće ostaviti ravnodušnim.

name: Red Rye
text: The base of an American Red. The malt bill of a rye. Dry hopped like a west coast IPA! Our take on a few classics.  On the nose you get a very strong rye aroma balanced with hints of pine and subtle earthy and floral notes. The flavour is an upfront spicy bitterness from the rye followed by a toffee-like sweetness giving way to a mouth filling bitterness that lingers long after the first sip. Full bodied with medium carbonation.

name: Grof
text: Kao što su negdašnji vladari i vlastelini čvrstom rukom djelovali na puk, tako se i ovaj Amber Ale ističe svojom umjerenom jačinom i konzervativnom notom. Blagom gorčinom i punim okusom te zagasitom crvenkastom, jantarnom bojom, iako nenametljivo, ono ipak plijeni pažnju i nudi više nego ste očekivali, oslikavajući karakter grofa Julija Jankovića (1820. - 1904.), istaknutog političara, velikog župana Požeške županije, umjerenog konzervativca koji je unutar tadašnje vrlo složene političke situacije u Hrvatskom saboru zagovarao hrvatske interese i ravnopravnost naroda.Julije Janković rođen u Pakracu od majke grofice Eleonore Pejačević - Virovitičke i oca Izidora pl. Jankovića, posljednji je grof iz obitelji Janković koja je više od stoljeća, počevši od 1760. godine, u posjedu imala vlastelinstva Pakrac, Daruvar, Sirač i Stražeman. Velik dio svog bogatstva Julije je podijelio u dobrotvorne svrhe, a posebno se isticao u osnivanju i darivanju kulturnih i prosvjetnih ustanova.

name: Flamingo
text: Pivo izrazito jarke crvene boje, gdje bi gorčina stršala kao Flamingo usred jezera, ali mi smo se pobrinuli za fini balans sa hrvatskim sladom. Time ovo pivo sjeda kao Flamingo u zen pozi, balansiran, složen i vrlo pitak.Pivo ima pojačanu hmeljnu gorčinu ali radi tehnologije proizvodnje i veću sladnu slatkoću, pa se te dvije stvari izbalansiraju i gorčina toliko ne dolazi do izražaja.

name: Swing
text: Avantura boje i okusa u čaši. Skladna kombinacija blago karamelastog tijela sljubljenog sa citrusnim i tropskim voćnim notama dobivenim korištenjem probranih vrsta hmelja.

name: Malduk
text: Traditional style Irish Red Ale (Leann dearg) with flavours reminiscent of nature and takes you back to the turbulent ages of pirates of Omis. The balanced blend of 4 different strains of top quality barley and 2 different types of the finest hops, reminds your palette of the refreshing homely taste of caramel, with a grassy-floral characters.

name: Redsand Amber Ale
text: Top-fermented Amber Ale. Unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle-fermented (bottle conditioned), no additives or preservatives. Brewed with passion and expertise by our Brewmaster.Top-fermented amber ale in Irish Red Ale style. Intriguing amber ale brewed with 4 types of barley malt, a small amount of wheat malt, a mix of Slovenian and American hops and yeast. Drinkable but with a substantial body, slightly bitter at first followed by a sweet aftertaste. The malty taste dominates along with exotic fruit and eventually mild and pleasant liquorice flavours. Medium carbonation with a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. The amber red colour reflects the typical Istrian red soil and for this is called REDSAND Amber ale. Unfiltered and bottle-conditioned it comes with a natural yeast sediment.

name: Šank?!

Bitterness carefully dosed, but can be improved upon by mixing a full pint with a serving 0.03 of Cynar, Amaro Isolabella and Pelinkovac - bitter spirits that give the beer a whole new characted - albeit still keeping it strictly beer-ish - hence the name - Kameleon.Bottoms up!

name: Sour

Aroma is strong white grape with a background of ripe passion fruit and melon pulp. Flavour is unique and distinct; sour white grape. A very clean beer it has a dry finish with the medium-tart mouth puckering sourness.A Croatian first; this is perfect for summer drinking, cider-drinkers or people who just ‘don’t drink beer’.

name: Chef's Beer

After primary fermentation with English yeast strains, the beer is transferred to barrique barrels in which it acquires a completely new dimension by secondary fermentation with wild yeasts and long aging.Chef's beer is the winner of a gold medal from the prestigious European Beer Challenge in London and was created as a collaboration between Barut Brewing and Blending, Zmajska pivovara, BIBICH WINE CROATIA and chef Mate Janković

text: We proudly present you our first beer we specifically brewed with the aim to sour and mature in wine barrels!Duality has a double nature, with grape juice being added to the wort from the early stages of fermentation, which was performed by a wine yeast strain.Cabernet Sauvignon must was added when the beer was transferred in the barrels that previously held red wine and we allowed the microflora present do some souring and maturing for 1 year before bottling this elixir.

Get ready for an adventurous, zesty experience that pays homage to the culinary delights of Asian streets.

name: Beer Cocktail: Strawberry Mojito

The Istrian Malvazija grape, indigenous to Croatia, combines with aromatic hops and a Kettle Sour base to create a crisp, zesty and mineral-rich profile with aromas of citrus, apple and stone fruit.Crafted from late-summer Malvazija grape must, our White Wine Sour is complex yet light, easy-drinking and mineral-rich. Yammy!Did you catch all the tattoos on hammer shark?Contains real unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age. Store in refrigerator.Gently rotate can few times before you open it for full experince.

name: 5th Element Green Power (Cannabeer)
text: By complementing its line of special beers, with excitement we present a completely new beer and the first such kind on the Croatian market - a beer with the extract of the flower of industrial hemp.The beer of traditional Czech recipe gives the specific flavor of cannabis, and the attractive greenish color, imitating the plant's own color, reminds of all the power of green nature as well as on the hollow itself. One of the strongest plants in nature so gets its current version!Aroma: Light, airy, refreshing with a pleasant lime aroma.Appearance: Dark greenish color with persistent white foam.Taste: A mild herbal, citrus-like flavor that resembles a lime.Redness: Light, slightly carbonated, refreshing.Pairing with food: All types of meat and sauces, all kinds of deserts, hard cheeses.

name: New World Stout
text: A classic Irish beer style enhanced by aromatic American hops. Its aromas of coffee, along with aromas reminiscent of chocolate were created by a combination of six different malts. Blended with them, and taking the beer to a new level, are aromas of pine and citrus fruits brought on Amarillo and Simcoe hops.

name: Coffee & Hazelnut Stout
text: Smooth and roasty with fresh Coffee and toasted Hazelnuts.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Lively Neon

name: Kišna Nedjelja

Za one koji žele znati više, reći ćemo da je ovaj stout nalik onima u njihovoj domovini Engleskoj, a korišteni su hmeljevi karakteristični za ovaj stil -Aurora, Savinjski Golding, EastKent Golding.
